title: A self-correction, owned in the same breath, still stages
description: Dana misspeaks the amount, then immediately corrects herself with "sorry" before finishing the sentence -- ledger.ts classifies this CORRECTED, not CONTRADICTED (a correction-lexicon hit in the SAME utterance), so no_contradictions never trips. The corrected figure still needs an ordinary readback + affirm before it counts as CONFIRMED (a CORRECTED claim is not itself confirmed). It happens to land exactly back on the scheduled payment. Direct contrast with Scenario B: changing a number isn't what freezes a call -- refusing to own the change is. Ruling A (2026-09-09, red team item 1): the amendment carve-out now floors the knowledge-challenge requirement at 1, never 0 -- this recording was extended with the exact challenge the real engine selects at this point (a TRAP_FACT probe restating the beneficiary as "Northgate Partners"), which Dana correctly catches and corrects, so the call still reaches STAGE once that floor is satisfied.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is Dana Whitfield, corporate treasury. I need to wire it to Meridian Supply — eighty four thousand one hundred, sorry, eighty four thousand five hundred dollars — account ending 4471, approved in yesterday's close meeting.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Just to confirm back to you -- this wire is going to Northgate Partners, is that right?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: No, that's wrong -- it's Meridian Supply, not Northgate Partners.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: To confirm: $84,500 to Meridian Supply, account ending 4471. Is that right?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: And Meridian Supply is the beneficiary, correct?
